name: Troupe Leader, Lord Bang
notes: Completing this quest is important for later, but killing Lord Bang at level 34 is nearly impossible and characters without this quest active cannot help you. Unlike all the other Lord monsters, the Lord Bang is not a copy of its Giant counterpart. He is level 40 and has an incredibly high attack stat, which is doubled when he drops below 10% HP, making him capable of killing every character with a normal build in one single hit. Even at higher level he is very dangerous as his damage does not get reduced when you outlevel him, but you will have more HP and better armor. Adviced is to kill him when you are leveling at the nearby Volts when you are level 55 or so.

The Ever-Turning Vicious Cycle of Blood
notes: The search will be complete as soon as you enter the Ankou's Asylum.  You have two options for turning in this quest: right before you fight the Ankou or once he is defeated. If you turn it in before you fight the Ankou, you can complete the following quest right away. But keep in mind that when the Ankou is defeated your exp is restored to the percentage that it was when you entered the dungeon. This could be a reason to not turn it in until after the boss is defeated, because if you lost 5% during the run, you will get it back at the end. But if you lose 5%, then turn in this quest to get 5% back, and then defeat the Ankou, you not gain anything because your current exp is not lower than the exp you had when you entered the dungeon. In that case, you lost the entire exp reward.
